resources.string: Review and correct the detected contact data before exporting a vCard.

Open the three-dot menu on any scanned PDF and choose Scan business card. The app runs OCR and extracts name, organisation, job title, email addresses, phone numbers, websites, and address. Review and edit the detected fields, then tap Add to contacts to save directly to your contacts app, or Share vCard to send the file.
The business card scanner runs OCR on a PDF page, extracts structured contact data, and exports a vCard 3.0 file that can be added to your contacts app or shared.
